niche_preference_profile: Prefers interfaces with strong, explicit structure and hierarchy: clearly separated sections, labeled controls, card-based grouping, and obvious focal actions. Generally favors light neutral backgrounds with restrained purple accents, spacious layouts, softer rounded components, and reduced visual clutter. Often prefers concise text, clearer labels, and integrated contextual information over decorative, overly dark, neon, busy, or weakly structured presentations. In some data-dense analytic contexts, they also respond positively to richer tool visibility and embedded status/context panels, but overall the dominant pattern is organized, readable, spacious, and polished UI.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers clear hierarchy with obvious titles, labels, grouped sections, selected-state summaries, and well-structured card or list organization rather than flat, weakly grouped, or context-poor layouts.

Usually prefers light neutral backgrounds, soft gray surfaces, and subtle purple or blue accents over dark, neon, high-contrast, or heavily saturated themes; when dark is used, prefers warmer charcoal and restrained accenting.
Prefers more breathing room, open space, fewer competing elements, and lower decorative clutter over dense, busy, tightly packed, or visually noisy compositions.
Prefers call-to-action elements that are easy to find and clearly emphasized, with visible labeled buttons integrated into the hierarchy rather than weak, faded, hidden, or overly fragmented actions.
Prefers polished card-based UI with rounded corners, subtle borders or shadows, soft elevation, and contained elements rather than flat, harsh, or weakly defined components.

Prefers shorter cleaner headlines, concise body copy, explicit text labels, full-word labeling, and readable guidance instead of verbose, abbreviated, placeholder-only, or overly dense text treatments.

Prefers information density that feels intentionally organized: often simpler and more focused in consumer/task flows, but supportive of richer detail when embedded in a strongly structured analytic or tool-oriented layout.
